temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites him to a weekend retreat, Gary declines because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was dedicated to his hospital work, but had not yet fully recognized the severity of Gary's unhealthy work habits.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan now believes Gary's overwork is serious enough to threaten his health and that Gary is reluctant to step away from work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overworking to an unhealthy degree and needs help or intervention, even though he currently refuses to take a break.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and somewhat disappointed by Gary's refusal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary by encouraging him to rest and reconsider taking time off, or otherwise find a way to support his health.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary's overwork was mainly due to hospital workload and hoped the retreat would help him relax.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restlessness and avoidance suggest there is more behind his overworking than professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is likely hiding or struggling with a deeper problem and may need a nonjudgmental confrontation and support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently about his suspicions and offer a safe space for Gary to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspected Gary was dealing with more than ordinary work stress and wanted him to open up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan now understands the specific causes: new department pressures and personal challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is understandable given his responsibilities and personal difficulties; with help, he can find better balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief mixed with empathy and compassion.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and create a healthier work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Gary reports progress and ongoing challenges; he says he is less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary could improve with ongoing support and practical schedule changes, though challenges might remain.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary is actively making efforts and showing measurable improvement; Ethan's support seems to be helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is on a positive path and can continue improving with encouragement and check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in with Gary, offering support and encouragement as he manages remaining challenges.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and says he feels more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was improving but might still need regular support and monitoring.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary now appears capable of managing his balance independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has successfully achieved a healthier balance and no longer needs Ethan's active intervention, though Ethan remains available.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied, happy, and proud for Gary.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support while letting Gary know he is always available if needed.
